title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---: how the half-digit item heals, in Lean
text: The half-digit item 11 [Q] 00 11 [Q'] 01 [P] of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE--- is now proved through the wraps of Q. The cells 0011 after Q act as one more digit: the first wrap turns them into 0111, the second into the Q digit 0 with 2 added to Q', and the tape reads in the grammar again. chain_event_junction proves this for every width; in the 500-stage run all 34 events at such wraps follow it.
